honest_caveats_c3: 1) Legacy hf.token may still be referenced in unaudited locations (worktrees, archive dirs, historical state JSONs were intentionally excluded; if any branch is later resurrected from those worktrees its code may still try `secret get hf.token` and fail).

2) secret rm timing risk N/A — hf.token already absent, but if a future operator re-adds it (muscle memory) sister tooling will silently prefer huggingface.token without warning the operator about the duplicate.

3) Env var precedence change: HF_TOKEN env was previously TIER 1 (highest priority, overrode every file/secret); now it is TIER 3 (lowest, only used if secret store empty AND ~/.cache/huggingface/token missing). Operators relying on HF_TOKEN to override a stale secret store value must either `secret rm huggingface.token` first OR delete ~/.cache/huggingface/token. This is a BREAKING semantic change for anyone who used HF_TOKEN as an override.

4) Fallback chain shorter: removed ~/.huggingface/token, /workspace/.hf_token, and HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN env. Operators using huggingface_hub<0.17 (which wrote ~/.huggingface/token) or RunPod /workspace/.hf_token bootstrap scripts will need migration. The /workspace/.hf_token path was used by some pod bootstrap; verify pod entrypoints write to ~/.cache/huggingface/token instead OR run `secret set` inside the pod.
